payload.summary: Closed the terminal all-harness plan gate with operator adjudication. Revision 8 defines deterministic multi-sidecar merge, producer-specific destinations, shared lifecycle-aware dependency resolution, and immutable-source-derived IDs, and repairs confirmed scenario coverage.
completed_work: Attempted all five configured harnesses and reached 3/5 substantive quorum.
Applied all four operator-approved high-impact decisions.
Added cross-producer deterministic, atomic, collision, merge, and refine-roadmap verification coverage.
Advanced the approved implementation plan to revision 8.

decisions.title: Merge repeatable candidate-work inputs
decisions.rationale: The integration flow must consume all producer sidecars without hand concatenation.

decisions.title: Protect producer-specific sidecars
decisions.rationale: Defaults cannot erase another producer batch and explicit cross-generator collisions must fail unchanged.

decisions.title: Resolve dependencies by lifecycle identity
decisions.rationale: Ranking and intake must agree when terminal artifacts and live records share a change ID.

decisions.title: Derive the complete ID from immutable source identity
decisions.rationale: A stable hash is insufficient if a mutable title still controls the readable base.

next_steps: Implement the five-package ri-12 DAG tests-first, then run implementation review and validation.
